values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are not permitted at DEC campgrounds. DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident and the 1-night reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 season Jun 28 - Oct 10 (matches the manual season; the late opening is for infrastructure work). Added 126 sites (DEC) to 30 ft (91 sites; all back-in), no electric, 9-month window, 14-night max (DEC row, now on the entry), no walk-ins, showers, flush toilets, dump. AWH note kept.
flags: Season: the manual opens 06-28 is a one-year delay - ReserveAmerica: '2027 Camping Season: Please be advised that Eighth Lake will open on June 28th, 2027, to accommodate scheduled infrastructure work within the facility.' DEC's 2026 summary opened it May 15 (closing Oct 12). After 2027 the opening should revert to mid-May; suggest a season note saying so.
Missing phone: Eighth Lake Campground 315-354-4120 (DEC 2026 campground summary).

Missing operator website: the entry has only the ReserveAmerica link; add DEC's campground page (likely dec.ny.gov/places/eighth-lake-campground-and-day-use-area, following the pattern of the other DEC entries; dec.ny.gov answers 403 to scripted reads, so the path was not opened).

Weak waterfront lead: ReserveAmerica tags every campsite 'Near Water - no', while the entry is lakefront. Probably RA's default tag at DEC campgrounds; listed only because it is a booking-engine water claim contrary to ours.
